title: Estimating Desk Calculation Note: The Line-Set Change-Order Charge on Replacement System Installations
content:
# The line-set change-order charge

## Calculation clause

A new refrigerant line set that the package does not include is billed as a numbered change order, and the line-set change-order charge is the package's line-set change-order price, rounded to the cent half up.

The package's line-set change-order price is the figure listed for the Replacement System Installations package of the project on the field estimating rate card.

## Sequence of the computation

The line-set change-order charge is built on the package's line-set change-order price in a fixed sequence:

1. a credit against the price is taken off first, and the amount never goes below zero;
2. the amount left is multiplied by the share at which the change order is charged;
3. a percentage discount on the change order is a percentage of the amount from stage 2 and is taken off that same amount;
4. a percentage fee on the change order is a percentage of the reduced amount from stage 3 and is added to it;
5. a flat administration fee is added last;
6. only the final total is rounded to the cent half up; no figure before the final total is rounded.

A stage with nothing to apply leaves the amount as it stands: a credit of 0.00 takes nothing off, a share of 100 percent keeps the whole amount, a discount or fee of 0 percent changes nothing and a flat fee of 0.00 adds nothing.

## Worked example (hypothetical project)

A hypothetical Harbison Advantage Series System project, whose line-set change-order price is $895.00, is billed a new line set as change order number 1. The line-set change-order charge is $895.00, rounded to the cent: $895.00.

## Worked sequence (hypothetical stage values)

To show the order of the stages on a hypothetical $895.00 price with a $100.00 credit, a 90 percent share, an 8 percent discount, a 3 percent fee and a $20.00 flat fee:

| Stage | Computation | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | $895.00 less $100.00 | $795.00 |
| 2 | $795.00 multiplied by 90 percent | $715.50 |
| 3 | $715.50 less 8 percent of $715.50 ($57.24) | $658.26 |
| 4 | $658.26 plus 3 percent of $658.26 ($19.7478) | $678.0078 |
| 5 | $678.0078 plus $20.00 | $698.0078 |
| 6 | Rounded to the cent half up | $698.01 |
